issue: NFL.com publishes no spreads, totals, moneylines or prices, and no primary operator price feed was reachable from this environment (nfl.com/betting/ returns 404; DraftKings, FanDuel and BetMGM pages are geolocation-gated). Market line, market price, difference, CLV and market ROI are therefore blank.
recommended_action: Establish a licensed primary price feed (for example a state lottery or operator API) and re-run pipeline.py to populate the market columns.

issue: Closing price records exist for every originated market, but the market price field is blank until a primary source is established.
recommended_action: Re-run the snapshot appender after a price source is available; the store is append-only so existing records are preserved.

issue: The official Texans depth chart is published only as a raster image, so no machine-readable rows could be transcribed. Every Texans depth value is blank.
recommended_action: Manual review of the published image (manual review link provided) and then a hand transcription into depth_raw.py.

issue: The official Week 10 injury report capture for Kansas City was truncated at a page-chunk boundary, so the Chiefs rows may be incomplete.
recommended_action: Re-capture the Chiefs block of the official injury report and re-transcribe.

issue: The official Week 10 injury report rows for Tennessee arrived in two non-contiguous page segments and were assembled manually.
recommended_action: Re-capture the Titans block and confirm row order against the official page.

issue: 185 official rows carry no game-status designation. These are recorded as 'No designation published' and are never treated as healthy.
recommended_action: No action; the distinction is published as a first-class field.

issue: 61 players on the official Week 10 injury report have no entry on their club's official depth chart, so their depth tier is blank.
recommended_action: Confirm whether the player is a practice participant only, on another unit's list, or missing from the club chart.

issue: HOME_FIELD_POINTS = 2.0 is a model assumption, not an official statistic, and is the only non-official number inside the line engine.
recommended_action: Sensitivity test the parameter across a plausible range; the published lines move one point for each half-point of HFA.

issue: SIGMA is the empirical SD of walk-forward margin residuals from this season so far; it will change as the sample grows.
recommended_action: Recompute automatically at every build (the pipeline already does).

issue: The NFL.com team-stats pages present multi-value tiles whose labels and values cannot be paired without ambiguity, so no advanced-stat value was transcribed.
recommended_action: Use the NFL.com Game Book PDF or the club statistics pages if advanced stats are required.
